name: CPI Inflation
description: The Consumer Price Index (base 2024=100) measures the average change in prices households pay for a basket of goods and services. It is India's headline inflation number and the RBI's policy target of 4%, with a tolerance band of 2-6%.
source: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
releaseSchedule: Released monthly, around the 12th, for the previous month. The latest month is provisional.

chart.title: Retail inflation has risen every month this year
chart.subtitle: All-India CPI (combined), year-on-year %, 2026. September is provisional.
